_comment: Engine sampler spec of one National Compute MI355X node (8 x MI355X, vLLM ROCm) for a
Kimi-K3.1 async GRPO run, in the dedicated image pins.VLLM_SAMPLER_IMAGE_ROCM
--spec THIS.json --r2-env-file ENV). The engine section is the vllm-server adapter on the
upstream line with the k31_preset amd-article (AMD's published TP8 + DCP8 layout without
speculative decoding and CPU KV offload); rl-precision is the same layout with BF16
all-reduce / MoE combine / KDA input projections and an FP32 KDA state. vLLM refuses R3
(routed_experts) with DCP / PCP > 1, so this R3 server runs the preset at DCP 1 (the MLA KV
cache whole on every rank, about 1/8 of the DCP8 KV token capacity; the load detail records
it as r3_cp_overrides): keep max_num_seqs x max_model_len inside it. Reload is by restart
(in-place reload_weights is not measured on this image). Every value in angle brackets is a
site value the launch layer fills in; the store and prompts sections are as in

server.base_dir: <nvme path of the Kimi-K3.1 MXFP4 checkpoint>

prompts.tokenizer: <nvme path of the Kimi-K3.1 MXFP4 checkpoint>
